import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_public_road_length_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Row 14 (index 14) to row 64 (index 64) are states
state_df = df.iloc[14:65].copy()
# Column 0 is state name, Column 8 is Rural Total
state_df[8] = pd.to_numeric(state_df[8])
# Exclude DC if present
state_df = state_df[state_df[0] != 'District of Columbia']
top3 = state_df.sort_values(by=8, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[0].tolist()

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_public_road_length_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)

fl_val = float(df[df[0] == 'Florida'].iloc[0, 9])
result = 'New York' if ny_val > fl_val else 'Florida'

import pandas as pd
